en.t: I was not in the least intoxicated by understanding.

units.source_text: 毋宁说我的认识被蹂躏、被侮蔑了。

en.t: Rather, my understanding had been trampled on and insulted.
Life and desire were even more beyond question!

units.source_text: ……然而深深的忧惚感没有离开我，我仿佛麻痹了一阵子，面对着她的裸露的乳房而坐了下来。

en.t: ...Yet the deep sense of melancholy did not leave me; as if numbed for a while, I sat down facing her naked breasts.
